discovery_question: How many different systems does your branch log into daily? List them ALL by name.
townsq_capability: After config — TownSq Business (back-office) and TownSq Community (homeowner portal) are separate logins; WorkPoints+ is the accounting core.

discovery_question: Who manages user account creation, modification and removal today? What is the process when a new employee starts?
townsq_capability: After config — User accounts created and managed in TownSq admin console.

discovery_question: What is the step-by-step process when a user is locked out or needs a password reset?
townsq_capability: Native — Standard email-based password reset and account recovery.

discovery_question: When you find a system bug or need to report a technical problem, what do you do? Who do you contact and how?
townsq_capability: After config — Support tickets submitted via TownSq Help Center portal or Associa internal ticketing.

discovery_question: Who is responsible for managing user security and permissions? Can you restrict what different roles can see or do?
townsq_capability: After config — TownSq Business supports role-based permissions.

discovery_question: Do any board members have direct login access to your systems today? If yes, what can they see or do?
townsq_capability: After config — Board members can be granted TownSq Community access.

discovery_question: Do any affiliated groups — attorneys, collections agencies — have direct access to your systems to manage delinquencies?
townsq_capability: Partial — External users (attorneys) can be given read-only Community access but there is no dedicated attorney/legal portal.

discovery_question: Do you have a policy for user access when someone is on extended leave? Describe what happens to their access.
townsq_capability: Not supported — No formal LOA workflow.

discovery_question: Are your association IDs consistent (all letters, all numbers, or a mix)? Provide an example. How are they assigned?
townsq_capability: After config — Association records structured with a unique ID, legal name, unit count, management contract details.

discovery_question: Do you have a complete list showing the number of units in each association? How current and reliable is that data?
townsq_capability: After config — Unit/lot records imported via data migration template.

discovery_question: Can you provide a list of Tax IDs for all associations? Are associations listed by common name or legal name?
townsq_capability: After config — Tax ID field exists on the association record.

discovery_question: Walk through your step-by-step process for setting up a new client when they transition in. Who is involved and how long does it take?
townsq_capability: After config — No automated transition-in wizard; new association setup is a multi-step manual process.

discovery_question: What is your process for setting up an account for a prior owner in cases like foreclosure or bankruptcy? How are their balances tracked?
townsq_capability: After config — Prior/settled owner accounts can be maintained in TownSq with outstanding balances flagged.

discovery_question: How do you currently search for a community or association record? What fields can you search by?
townsq_capability: Native — Community search available by name, ID, or manager in TownSq Business.

discovery_question: How do you view and update property facts for an association — unit counts, amenities, legal descriptions? Where does that information live?
townsq_capability: After config — Association profile holds key facts.

discovery_question: Can you search or filter associations by criteria other than name — for example, by manager, unit count, property type, or status?
townsq_capability: Partial — Basic filtering by manager and status available.

discovery_question: Does each association have its own approved vendor list? Where is it stored and how do managers access it?
townsq_capability: After config — No dedicated per-association vendor list module.

discovery_question: How do you currently maintain the list of board members for each association — name, role, contact info, and term? What system holds this?
townsq_capability: After config — Board member contacts stored in the association record.

discovery_question: What is your process for updating board member information after an election or appointment? Who makes the change and where?
townsq_capability: Not supported — No election cycle or appointment tracking workflow.

discovery_question: Do you track board member certification or training requirements (e.g., state-mandated education hours)? If yes, how and where?
townsq_capability: Not supported — No board member certification module.

discovery_question: How do you currently search for a homeowner record — by name, address, account number? What system do you use?

discovery_question: How do you view a homeowner's current account balance and payment history? What system shows this?
townsq_capability: Native — Current account balance, payment history, and open charges visible in TownSq Business.

discovery_question: How do you currently identify and log a violation — drive-by inspection, homeowner complaint, or technology? Walk through creating a violation record.
townsq_capability: After config — Full violation creation and tracking module native to TownSq.

discovery_question: How are maintenance requests or work orders submitted at your branch — by managers, homeowners, or onsite staff? Walk through the full process.
townsq_capability: After config — Work order module available in TownSq.

discovery_question: Walk through your AP process step by step — from invoice receipt to payment. Who touches it at each stage?
townsq_capability: After config — AP invoice entry and routing native in TownSq Business (WorkPoints+).

discovery_question: Do you use lockbox processing for homeowner assessment payments? Which bank? What percentage of homeowners pay through the lockbox?

townsq_capability: Associa uses a standardized chart of accounts across associations.

discovery_question: Who enters the proposed budget for each association — the manager, an admin, or an accountant? What system is used?
townsq_capability: After config — Budget entry module in TownSq Business.

discovery_question: How are late fees and interest set up in your system? Do any associations have split-date rules or tiered fee structures?
townsq_capability: Late fees and interest are configured at the association level and can include complex rules.

townsq_capability: After config — Statement and coupon setup in TownSq via third-party mailing vendor integration.
